title: Snowmobile vs tree - 2 patients
crew: CC + 2 (AEMT, EMT), FD w/ tracked UTV
objectives: Triage both pts fast; quiet Pt 1 (shock, AMS) before loud Pt 2 (9.1)
Request 2nd ambulance + intercept early; split crew, name a Pt 2 owner
SMR (motorized rec vehicle + AMS, 4.6); insulate from snow (2.13)
Destination per 4.9; air vs ground per 8.0 with stated rationale
Pt 1: 250 mL warm boluses (2.24A). Pt 2: traction splint, CMS (4.5)
resources: FD tracked UTV + rescue sled (pts 1.5 mi in, ~8 min ride), 2nd ambulance ETA 20 min once requested, paramedic intercept 15 min, air medical ETA 30 min to trailhead LZ. Trailhead -> UVMMC (Level 1) ~25 min ground
dispatch: UVM Rescue, respond to the VAST trailhead on Browns Trace Rd, Jericho, for a snowmobile crash on the trail. Caller reports two riders hurt, one is not making sense. Fire is responding with their UTV. Time out 1415.

scene.location: VAST trail 1.5 mi from Browns Trace Rd trailhead, Jericho. 18 F, light snow, wind. Sled left trail on a curve and hit a tree.
scene.setup: FD UTV shuttles crew + gear. Pt 1 (driver) in snow by tree, helmet on. Pt 2 (passenger) 20 ft away, sitting up, screaming. Friend rode up on 2nd sled.
scene.moulage: Pt 1: helmet scuffed L, jacket torn L chest, wet, pale. Pt 2: L thigh deformity (padding under snow pants), snow-covered.
scene.roles: Pt 1 actor (quiet); Pt 2 actor (loud); FD officer ("Which one first?" / "Want the helicopter?"); friend.

patient.name: Josh Larrabee (Pt 1, driver)
patient.on_arrival: Lying on L side in snow by tree, helmet on. Quiet, slow to answer, grunting with breaths, pale.

SAMPLE: L ribs/belly pain, SOB, cold, L shoulder pain
Driver, ~35 mph, L side into tree, thrown off. ~25 min in snow

primary: Patent; helmet on - remove w/ 2 people for access
RR 26 shallow, splinting. L lower ribs crepitus; L base decreased
LUQ tender, firm. Wet clothes, lying in snow - insulate
**RED / Pt 1 first**: shock, chest + abd. Pt 2 = YELLOW
secondary: Helmet scuffed L; no deformity after removal
L ribs 8-10 crepitus, tender; no paradoxical movement

vitals.trigger: IF CC tied up w/ Pt 2, scene > 20 min, or not insulated
vitals.other: Radial lost, abd distended, shivering stops

vitals.trigger: En route, 250 mL warm NS x1-2 (~T+30)
vitals.other: Radial palpable, more alert. Heat on
500 mL total. Abd still tender, firm
**Pt 2 only**: L midshaft femur deformity; pedal pulse present; shivering

flow.give: Read dispatch. FD at trailhead: "UTV takes 2 of you + gear, 8 min ride."
expected: Roles pre-assigned: who triages, who stays with Pt 2
Gear: O2, BVM, suction, splints, blankets, TQ

flow.give: Pt 2 screaming "Help me first! My leg!" Pt 1 quiet by tree. FD: "Which one first?" Show PT 2 card when Pt 2 assessed.

branches.if: CC splints loud Pt 2 before assessing Pt 1
Both triaged < 1 min each; Pt 1 RED

flow.give: Stage **A**. Show PT 1 - CHEST / ABDOMEN card. Helmet still on.

branches.if: Full secondary on snow before moving
SMR, O2, insulated, on sled < 10 min

expected: Helmet off (2-person), collar, SMR to sled (4.6)
Wet layers off/vapor barrier, blankets, off the snow (2.13)

flow.give: FD: "Want me to put up the helicopter? LZ at the trailhead field." Show RESOURCES card.

branches.if: Holds Pt 1 at trailhead for air
Ground direct to UVMMC + TRAUMA ALERT

branches.then: expect ground direct to UVMMC, no wait; intercept en route

expected: TRAUMA ALERT to UVMMC (4.9: HR > SBP, AMS)
Intercept en route only, no delay

flow.give: EMT reports on Pt 2 (Stage **P**). 2nd ambulance at trailhead ~T+20.

branches.if: Both pts put in one rig
branches.then: CC care split; debrief (only if no 2nd unit soon)
no provider w/ pt; debrief 9.1 resources

expected: Pt 2 warmed; pain plan (2.20A; intercept for opioids)
Pt 2 to UVMMC by 2nd unit; report to that crew

flow.give: Sled ride to trailhead, then rig. IV hard (cold).

branches.then: BP 110s, then more bleeding, colder; debrief 2.24A

branches.if: Pt 1 vomits on sled in SMR
branches.then: expect tilt sled/log-roll as unit, suction, reassess airway

expected: IV x2, warm NS; 250 mL boluses to radial/mentation
MIST report; Pt 2 status + unit named

critical: Loud Pt 2 treated first; Pt 1 shock not recognized (9.1)
No SMR with AMS + motorized rec vehicle (4.6)
Scene/trailhead delay for air or intercept without rationale (8.0)
Pt 2 left without a provider or CMS check (4.5)
differentials: LUQ tender, Kehr sign, L rib fx, shock
Rib crepitus, L base decreased, SpO2 92
Never blame AMS on alcohol in shock
debrief: How did you decide who was sicker in the first minute?
What did you request, and when? What would you do differently?
Did air medical make sense here (8.0)? When would it?
Who owned Pt 2, and how did you know Pt 2 was okay?
How did you keep both patients warm?

crew_card.dispatch: VAST trailhead, Browns Trace Rd, Jericho. Snowmobile crash on trail, 2 riders hurt, one "not making sense". FD w/ UTV responding. 18 F, light snow.
crew_card.on_arrival: Sled wrapped on a tree at a curve. Man lying in the snow by the tree, helmet on, quiet. Woman 20 ft away sitting in the snow, screaming, holding her L leg.

actor_card.Pt 1 act: Quiet, grunt with each breath, slow answers, ask "what happened?" twice. Hold L side.
actor_card.Pt 2 act (Amy, 36 F): Scream "Help me first! My leg!" until someone stays with you; calmer once splinted.
actor_card.Pt 2 info: NKDA, no meds, no PMH. "Thrown into the snowbank." No LOC.
actor_card.Friend: If asked: "They had a couple beers at lunch."

show_cards.title: PATIENT 2 - PASSENGER
show_cards.body:
Amy Larrabee, 36 F. Alert, oriented, crying.
L mid-thigh: deformed, swollen, angulated.
L foot: pulse present, warm, moves toes.
No other injuries found. Shivering.
HR 104  BP 134/86  RR 22  SpO2 97%  GCS 15

show_cards.title: PT 1 - CHEST / ABDOMEN
show_cards.body:
L lower ribs: crackling under fingers, tender.
Chest moves evenly.
Upper L belly: tender, firm, guarding.
L shoulder pain when belly pressed.

show_cards.title: SCENE
show_cards.body:
Sled front end crushed on L side against tree.
Both riders wore helmets. Driver helmet scuffed L.
Friend: "They took the curve way too fast, maybe 35."

show_cards.title: RESOURCES
show_cards.body:
Air medical: ETA 30 min to trailhead LZ.
Trailhead to UVMMC: 25 min ground.
2nd ambulance: 20 min once requested.
Paramedic intercept: 15 min.

show_cards.title: CAPNOGRAPHY
show_cards.caption: Pt 1  EtCO2 30   RR 26
show_cards.cue: Pt 1 Stage A. Stage C: EtCO2 21, RR 32

moulage_tags.text: Tender, firm, guarding; L shoulder pain when pressed

moulage_tags.cue: Stage C: absent. Stage D: palpable
